research_question: Can a frozen operation-context contract be translated into fail-closed, backend-shaped safety hints for cedar, HyCache, and Cachew without making cost or placement decisions?

scope.evidence_role: synthetic interface-conformance and claim-scope test only
non_claims: No backend source code is imported or modified.
No optimizer cost, tier, placement, worker, or ILP decision is made.
No empirical backend compatibility, speedup, or final-blind accuracy is claimed.
ReplayCapabilityV1 is not generalized into cache or reorder capability.

frozen_translation_rules.strict_cache_eligible: semantic=admit AND source=supported AND randomness=none AND execution_state=none AND external_io=none AND cardinality=one_to_one
frozen_translation_rules.parameter_replay: replay_only randomness never becomes ordinary backend cacheable; emit a parameter-record cache-key obligation and keep HyCache/Cachew caching disabled unless a future backend-specific keyed-cache protocol exists
frozen_translation_rules.unknown: Any unknown semantic/source/effect dimension disables cache and reorder across that operator and emits a fail-closed barrier.
frozen_translation_rules.reject: Semantic reject disables candidate generation and emits a barrier with the semantic reason.
frozen_translation_rules.cedar: Emit random, fix, depends_on, and contract provenance hints only.
frozen_translation_rules.hycache: Emit online_only per step and the largest safe contiguous prefix boundary; no ILP/tier/count decision.
frozen_translation_rules.cachew: Emit the largest safe contiguous prefix autocache boundary; no worker/storage policy.
frozen_translation_rules.invalidation: Every emitted hint bundle binds operation context, contract digest, source-index digest, and input-schema digest.

pass_rule: 12/12 gates must pass; otherwise preserve FAIL and do not claim optimizer integration readiness.
